declaration.preface: At Shenzhen Xingbiao Electronic Technology Co Ltd, we recognize that fair wages are fundamental to employee well-being and economic stability. A living wage ensures that employees earn enough to meet their basic needs, including housing, food, healthcare, education, and savings. Our commitment to providing a living wage aligns with our dedication to social responsibility, employee welfare, and ethical business practices. By implementing a structured living wage framework, we aim to foster financial security, job satisfaction, and long-term sustainability in our workforce.
declaration.declaration: Shenzhen Xingbiao Electronic Technology Co Ltd is committed to ensuring that all employees earn at least a living wage, which exceeds minimum wage requirements and reflects the actual cost of living. We will conduct periodic wage assessments, adjust compensation structures accordingly, and work with suppliers to promote fair wage practices across our value chain. Our commitment to fair wages contributes to employee well-being, increased productivity, and long-term business success.
declaration.scope: This policy is applicable to all employees, workers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders directly affiliated with us.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
A living wage ensures that employees earn enough to meet their basic needs, including housing, food, healthcare, education, and savings.

Shenzhen Xingbiao Electronic Technology Co Ltd is committed to ensuring that all employees earn at least a living wage, which exceeds minimum wage requirements and reflects the actual cost of living.

Ensure wages are fair, competitive, and aligned with locally applicable living wage benchmarks.

Ensure 100% of direct employees receive wages that meet or exceed applicable living wage benchmarks by 2030, using locally adjusted living wage calculation methodologies.

This policy is applicable to all employees, workers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders directly affiliated with us.

Ensure comprehensive benefit offerings including healthcare, retirement plans, and paid leave for all full-time staff.

Commit to continuously paying wages that meet or exceed applicable living wage standards, with periodic reviews to ensure alignment with local cost-of-living conditions.

The Head of HR will review this policy annually to ensure its effectiveness and compliance. Updates will be shared with stakeholders, and the company may revise the policy as needed to address regulatory or operational changes.

Fair Compensation: Promote regular internal reviews to align compensation with industry standards and employee well-being.
Foster a workplace culture where every employee receives fair and dignified compensation.
Ensure comprehensive benefit offerings including healthcare, retirement plans, and paid leave for all full-time staff.
Maintain a transparent and structured salary increase framework reflecting company performance and market conditions.
Living Wage Implementation: Ensure wages are fair, competitive, and aligned with locally applicable living wage benchmarks.
Integrate living wage principles into compensation planning, salary reviews, and workforce management.
Promote wage progression linked to skills development, experience, and performance.
Periodically review wage practices to maintain alignment with cost-of-living changes.
Wage Transparency: Strengthen awareness of compensation policies and pay structure among all management and HR teams.
Encourage open communication around pay structures and benefits during on boarding and performance reviews.
Integrate wage transparency principles into training modules and employee engagement programs.
Supplier Engagement: Support key suppliers in adopting responsible wage practices aligned with industry expectations.
Engage suppliers in dialogue and capacity-building around living wage implementation best practices.
Recognize suppliers that demonstrate leadership in fair compensation practices.
Wage Equity & Non-Discrimination: Promote equal pay for work of equal value, with adjustments based on performance, behavior, and experience.
Establish a proactive review mechanism to identify and address wage equity opportunities across the workforce.
Transparency and Communication: Promote clear and transparent communication regarding wages, benefits, and payroll processes.
Ensure employees have access to accurate and timely wage-related information.
Periodically communicate progress on living wage commitments to employees and relevant stakeholders.
Maintain accessible and confidential channels for employees to raise wage-related questions or concerns.
Commit to continuously paying wages that meet or exceed applicable living wage standards, with periodic reviews to ensure alignment with local cost-of-living conditions.

policy.monitoring:
Shenzhen Xingbiao Electronic Technology Co Ltd maintains a transparent and structured wage reporting and monitoring framework to track progress and ensure accountability.

Conduct comprehensive periodic wage assessments, including a breakdown of wage distribution, adjustments, and employee benefits enhancements.

Conduct and review insights into wage structure changes, supplier compliance status, and the implementation of corrective actions.

Ensure all wage-related data is compiled in compliance with regulatory requirements and shared with relevant stakeholders.

Conduct periodic key supplier audits to assess adherence to fair wage standards, with a focus on wage payments, benefits, and working conditions.

Establish a structured corrective action plan process to address non-compliance, with regular follow-ups and progress tracking.

Maintain confidential reporting channels, to include some combination of online portals, and direct HR access, Sr. Management access to allow employees to raise wage-related concerns.

Adhere to our resolution process to address employee grievances promptly, ensuring transparency and fair handling of all wage-related concerns.
